ttm.shares_basis: duration-weighted average of the four quarterly diluted weighted-average counts

dividends.dps_basis_detail: declared facts for periods ending 2007-12-31..2026-06-30; paid facts exist only inside that span and are not used; the paid tag stopped: its newest fact (2024-09-30) is 638 days older than the declared tag's (2026-06-30) — declared is primary
dividends.frequency_basis: 3 quarterly DPS facts inside FY2025 (2025-01-01..2025-12-31) plus one payment carried only in the FY total; the per-share facts are filed per quarter — a payment cadence inside the quarter (a monthly payer) is not tagged
dividends.fy_label_basis: calendar year of the fiscal period end (the annual table's convention)
dividends.flows_basis: sum of the four quarterly rows 2025-09-30..2026-06-30
dividends.shareholder_yield_basis: dividends_paid (4/4 quarters filed) + buybacks (4/4 quarters filed) − share_issuance (4/4 quarters filed); sum of the four quarterly rows 2025-09-30..2026-06-30
notes: quarterly DPS (paid): 2 quarter(s) filed at different values on the same share basis (2022-03-31: 0.47 (filed 2023-05-02) used, not 1.88 (filed 2025-02-13) — the filing that first reported the quarter (the year-to-date facts do not decide); 2023-03-31: 0.52 (filed 2024-05-07) used, not 2.08 (filed 2025-02-13) — the filing that first reported the quarter (the year-to-date facts do not decide)) — later 10-Ks and comparatives sometimes tag a year-to-date or annual value with a three-month context

dps_ttm: the latest four quarterly DPS facts are not consecutive quarters (182 days between 2025-09-30 and 2026-03-31) — FY2025 DPS 1.6 + the quarters since (2026-03-31: 0.44, 2026-06-30: 0.44) − the same quarters a year earlier (2025-03-31: 0.4, 2025-06-30: 0.4)
